notes: BUD-relative placement. defaults.by_tag/by_role seed many champs; heroes override. Relations: adjacent, not_adjacent, adjacent_behind, adjacent_column, same_or_one_behind, hew_teamwork, same_column, ahead, behind, farthest, front, back, not_front, not_edge, graph_distance_lte/gte, carry_not_edge, carry_column_distance_lte, prefer_column, avoid/prefer_adjacent_role, adjacent_count_lt, shadowheart_dex_spread. Batches A–E.

buffer.headline: {hero}: move next to BUD
buffer.detail: {hero} (slot {seat}) is a buffer and should sit adjacent to BUD {carry} (slot {carry_seat}).

debuffer.headline: {hero}: move next to BUD
debuffer.detail: {hero} (slot {seat}) debuffs best from a seat adjacent to BUD {carry} (slot {carry_seat}).

tank.headline: {hero}: tank belongs up front
tank.detail: {hero} is on slot {seat} ({zone}) — put tanks on the front line.

1.name: Bruenor
1.headline: {hero}: same column as BUD
1.detail: Bruenor should share BUD {carry}'s column (now column {carry_col}; Bruenor is column {hero_col}).

2.name: Celeste
2.headline: {hero}: prefer 2nd column
2.detail: Celeste is strongest in the 2nd formation column (0-based index 1); she is currently in column {hero_col}.

5.name: Calliope
5.headline: {hero}: stay within 2 seats of BUD
5.detail: Calliope's buff follows a 2-slot adjacent path (no jumping gaps). Distance to BUD {carry} is {distance} — move closer.

44.name: Qillek
44.headline: {hero}: avoid adjacent tanks
44.detail: Qillek should not sit next to tanks when possible — move him away from frontline tanks.

51.name: Avren
51.headline: {hero}: sit next to BUD
51.detail: Avren should sit adjacent to BUD {carry} (slot {carry_seat}) so Mirror Images land on your carry.

70.name: Ezmerelda
70.headline: {hero}: same column as BUD
70.detail: Ezmerelda is strongest in BUD {carry}'s column when the formation allows it (BUD column {carry_col}; Ezmerelda column {hero_col}).

74.name: Talin
74.headline: {hero}: sit next to BUD
74.detail: Talin should sit adjacent to BUD {carry} (slot {carry_seat}) when possible.

77.name: Alyndra
77.headline: {hero}: sit next to BUD
77.detail: Alyndra should sit adjacent to BUD {carry} so Portent stays on your carry.

126.name: Strongheart
126.headline: {hero}: sit next to BUD
126.detail: Strongheart's primary buff wants him adjacent to BUD {carry} (slot {carry_seat}).

128.name: Lae'zel
128.headline: {hero}: same column as BUD
128.detail: Lae'zel's main buff wants her in BUD {carry}'s column (BUD column {carry_col}; Lae'zel column {hero_col}).

139.name: Thellora
139.headline: {hero}: stand in front of BUD
139.detail: Thellora should sit in a column ahead of BUD {carry} (BUD column {carry_col}; Thellora column {hero_col}).

170.name: Lark
170.headline: {hero}: keep BUD off the edges
170.detail: Lark can sit anywhere, but BUD {carry} must not be in the front or back column (BUD is currently {carry_zone} / column {carry_col}).

171.name: Anson
171.headline: {hero}: stand in front of BUD
171.detail: Anson should sit in a column ahead of BUD {carry} (BUD column {carry_col}; Anson column {hero_col}).

172.name: Kyre
172.headline: {hero}: sit next to BUD
172.detail: Kyre's main buff wants them adjacent to BUD {carry} (slot {carry_seat}).

3.name: Nayeli
3.headline: {hero}: stand in front of BUD
3.detail: Nayeli's tank buffs usually want her ahead of BUD {carry} so the party behind her is covered (BUD column {carry_col}; Nayeli column {hero_col}).

11.name: Jamilah
11.headline: {hero}: sit next to a tank
11.detail: Jamilah's Bruiser-style setups want at least one tank adjacent to her.

34.name: Donaar
34.headline: {hero}: sit next to BUD
34.detail: Donaar's Duel/support options want him closer to BUD {carry} (slot {carry_seat}).

64.name: Beadle
64.headline: {hero}: stay within 2 seats of BUD
64.detail: Beadle's main buff wants him within 2 seats of BUD {carry} (distance {distance}).

80.name: Mehen
80.headline: {hero}: stand behind BUD
80.detail: Mehen is stronger the further back he sits from BUD {carry} (BUD column {carry_col}; Mehen column {hero_col}).

84.name: Prudence
84.headline: {hero}: pack more adjacents
84.detail: Prudence wants as many adjacent champions as practical — she currently has {adjacent_count}.

104.name: Voronika
104.headline: {hero}: same column as BUD
104.detail: Voronika's Battle Magic should hit BUD {carry}'s column (BUD column {carry_col}; Voronika column {hero_col}).

106.name: Blooshi
106.headline: {hero}: keep off the front line
106.detail: Blooshi survives better off the front line until you deliberately tank with her (currently {zone}).

151.name: Umberto
151.headline: {hero}: keep BUD within 2 columns
151.detail: Umberto's main buff wants BUD {carry} within 2 columns (BUD column {carry_col}; Umberto column {hero_col}).

162.name: Vlithryn
162.headline: {hero}: stand behind BUD
162.detail: Place Vlithryn behind BUD {carry} so her positional buffs land (BUD column {carry_col}; Vlithryn column {hero_col}).

141.name: Shadowheart
141.headline: {hero}: spread from highest-DEX seat
141.detail: Invoke Duplicity sits on {dex_hero}. For Find Yourself, keep that seat ≥2 slots from Shadowheart (graph distance is {dex_distance}).

21.name: Birdsong
21.headline: {hero}: stay within 2 seats of BUD
21.detail: Birdsong buffs champions within two slots — keep BUD {carry} within distance 2 (now {distance}).

38.name: K'thriss
38.headline: {hero}: keep BUD as far as possible
38.detail: Unseen Encouragement hits the farthest champion from K'thriss — put BUD {carry} in the farthest column (BUD column {carry_col}; farthest is {farthest_col}).

39.name: Paultin
39.headline: {hero}: keep BUD off your seat edge
39.detail: Magical Secrets buffs non-adjacent champions — move BUD {carry} off Paultin's adjacent seats (BUD slot {carry_seat}).

49.name: Turiel
49.headline: {hero}: stay on the front line
49.detail: Turiel wants the front of the formation so columns behind him stack his buff (currently {zone}).

118.name: Fen
118.headline: {hero}: same column as BUD
118.detail: Fen's column buff wants BUD {carry} in her column (BUD column {carry_col}; Fen column {hero_col}).

138.name: Certainty
138.headline: {hero}: stand behind BUD
138.detail: Certainty buffs the row/column in front of her — sit behind BUD {carry} (BUD column {carry_col}; Certainty column {hero_col}).

147.name: Gale
147.headline: {hero}: stand behind BUD
147.detail: Gale buffs the two columns in front of him — place him behind BUD {carry} (BUD column {carry_col}; Gale column {hero_col}).

158.name: Kalix
158.headline: {hero}: keep BUD off your seat edge
158.detail: Do not put Primary DPS next to Kalix — move BUD {carry} off adjacent seats (BUD slot {carry_seat}).

164.name: Tess
164.headline: {hero}: stand in front of BUD
164.detail: Lead The Way buffs columns behind Tess — stand ahead of BUD {carry} (BUD column {carry_col}; Tess column {hero_col}).

166.name: Cazrin
166.headline: {hero}: stand behind BUD
166.detail: Cazrin buffs her column and columns in front — as support, sit behind BUD {carry} (BUD column {carry_col}; Cazrin column {hero_col}).

174.name: Tasslehoff
174.headline: {hero}: keep BUD off your seat edge
174.detail: Never put your DPS adjacent to Tasslehoff — move BUD {carry} off adjacent seats (BUD slot {carry_seat}).

59.name: Melf
59.headline: {hero}: stay within 3 seats of BUD
59.detail: Melf's buff reaches at most 3 seats — distance to BUD {carry} is {distance}. Sit mid-formation and as far as that range allows.

also.headline: {hero}: prefer a mid column
also.detail: Melf should avoid the front/back edge so his range can stretch toward BUD (currently {zone}).

73.name: Baeloth
73.headline: {hero}: BUD in an adjacent column
73.detail: Morbid Excitement buffs the columns ahead and behind Baeloth — put BUD {carry} one column away (BUD column {carry_col}; Baeloth column {hero_col}).

75.name: Hew Maan
75.headline: {hero}: keep BUD within Teamwork range
75.detail: Teamwork X is {teamwork_x} for this {formation_columns}-column formation — BUD {carry} is {column_distance} columns away (BUD column {carry_col}; Hew Maan column {hero_col}).

143.name: Karlach
143.headline: {hero}: BUD in your column or the one behind
143.detail: Karlach buffs her column and the column behind — put BUD {carry} there (BUD column {carry_col}; Karlach column {hero_col}).

176.name: Trixie
176.headline: {hero}: keep BUD adjacent behind you
176.detail: Trixie spreads from the adjacent seats behind her — place BUD {carry} adjacent and rear-er (BUD slot {carry_seat} / column {carry_col}).

180.name: Kitiara
180.headline: {hero}: keep BUD as far as possible
180.detail: Merciless Resolve wants BUD {carry} in the farthest column from Kitiara. BUD is column {carry_col}; farthest from Kitiara is column {farthest_col}.

also.headline: {hero}: pack more adjacents
also.detail: Kitiara stacks Merciless Resolve per adjacent champion — she only has {adjacent_count} neighbor(s).
